pr.title: fix(server): nested Claude subagents show while their parent agent is idle
pr.body:
A still-running Claude background agent can launch nested agents while the root is idle. Their rows and threads used to wait for the next root run, then inherit that run's attribution.

Publish those launches immediately when the owner's root completed, retain its original run/root/provider turn through progress and completion, and enroll late child threads by their exact live fork node. Interrupted/failed owners keep the buffer/wake path. Root notifications still wake the root; nested completion does not. Ordinary background-agent cards also keep their launch provider turn when updated during later runs, keeping web/mobile grouping consistent with their run.

Original implementation and reproduction by @juliusmarminge in [#20835](https://github.com/pingdotgg/t3code/pull/20835); original commits preserved. The rebuild uses a bounded shared outcome object rather than retained run history.

Verification at [d9b6d2460d](https://github.com/pingdotgg/t3code/commit/d9b6d2460d360d48f298c72d71d861df81cb6b33):

- 344 unit tests and 34 recorded Claude replays pass. Server typecheck, scoped lint/format pass; one baseline unused-layer lint warning.
- Four added unit cases and one strengthened existing replay in 3 existing files; 371 added test lines versus original 375. Main reversal and targeted guard/attribution mutations fail as expected.
- Two whole-PR rounds with independent Opus and Sol reviews; final round clean after fixing provider-turn attribution.
- Isolated Linux API returns both completed subagents on the owner's run/turn. Browser accessibility shows both cards and opening the grandchild thread works. This uses captured replay projections as a presentation fixture. Screenshots were inspected but text glyphs render blank in this headless environment, so API/accessibility/test proof replaces visual evidence.

[Before/after proof, review findings and verification details](https://gh-file-drop-api-prod-mi5fy3sowv63ufte.pinglabs.workers.dev/f/d2e438ef766aca9d/20835-proof-r2.md).

Limits: a later interrupted/failed root still removes settled context and buffers launches. The subscription-before-turn-attachment adoption window remains an unproven timing risk noted by reviewers. Multi-root-turn attribution uses synthetic frames; recorded replay proves persisted nested ordering and root-only wake. Authenticated live Claude timing, macOS, Windows, Electron desktop, iOS and Android remain unverified. Stop timeout/held-message drain are outside scope. Current-head CI: all executed Actions validation jobs pass, including all eight server shards, build/typecheck, lint and shared tests. Web/native/preview jobs skipped normally. A cancelled duplicate native fingerprint run was superseded by a successful run. CodeRabbit and Macroscope correctness pass; the separate Macroscope approvability result is neutral and remains a maintainer decision.

Tests: gpt-6-astra; implementation: gpt-6.1-sol; reviews: gpt-6-sol and claude-opus-5-5. Harness: Codex/Claude in T3 Code.

     ),
   );
 
+  it.effect.each(["interrupted", "failed", "completed"] as const)(
+    "routes an idle nested launch by its owner's %s outcome after a later turn",
+    (ending) =>
+      Effect.scoped(
+        Effect.gen(function* () {
+          const outerTaskId = "task-stopped-run-outer";
+          const outerToolUseId = "toolu-stopped-run-outer";
+          const nestedTaskId = "task-stopped-run-nested";
+          const nestedToolUseId = "toolu-stopped-run-nested";
+          const interruptStarted = yield* Deferred.make<void>();
+          const harness = yield* makeWakeHarnessWithOptions({
+            interrupt: Deferred.succeed(interruptStarted, undefined),
+          });
+          const idAllocator = yield* IdAllocator.IdAllocatorV2;
+          const now = yield* DateTime.now;
+          const userTurn = (attemptId: string, providerTurnOrdinal: number) =>
+            harness.runtime.startTurn(
+              makeClaudeTestTurnInput({
+                threadId: harness.threadId,
+                providerThread: harness.providerThread,
+                now,
+                attemptId: RunAttemptId.make(attemptId),
+                text: "Keep auditing.",
+                attachments: [],
+                providerTurnOrdinal,
+              }),
+            );
+          const nestedRows = () =>
+            harness.events.flatMap((event) =>
+              event.type === "subagent.updated" &&
+              event.subagent.nativeTaskRef?.nativeId === nestedTaskId
+                ? [event.subagent]
+                : [],
+            );
+
+          yield* userTurn("attempt-claude-stopped-run-1", 1);
+          yield* harness.offerAndWait(
+            makeSubagentTaskStartedFrame({
+              taskId: outerTaskId,
+              toolUseId: outerToolUseId,
+              uuid: "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000b01",
+            }),
+          );
+          const { subagent: owner } = yield* Queue.take(harness.subagentReceipts);
+          const ownerNode = harness.events.find(
+            (event) => event.type === "node.updated" && event.node.id === owner.id,
+          );
+          assert(ownerNode?.type === "node.updated");
+          if (ending === "interrupted") {
+            yield* harness.runtime
+              .interruptTurn({
+                providerThread: harness.providerThread,
+                providerTurnId: idAllocator.derive.providerTurn({
+                  driver: ClaudeAdapterV2.CLAUDE_PROVIDER,
+                  nativeTurnId: "turn:attempt-claude-stopped-run-1",
+                }),
+              })
+              .pipe(Effect.forkScoped);
+            yield* Deferred.await(interruptStarted);
+          }
+          yield* harness.offerAndWait(
+            makeResultFrame({
+              uuid: "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000b02",
+              result: "Owner turn ended.",
+              ...(ending === "completed"
+                ? {}
+                : { subtype: "error_during_execution", isError: true, errors: ["boom"] }),
+            }),
+          );
+          assert.equal((yield* Queue.take(harness.terminalReceipts)).status, ending);
+
+          // A later completed turn supplies the settled context, but does not own this agent.
+          yield* userTurn("attempt-claude-stopped-run-2", 2);
+          yield* harness.offerAndWait(
+            makeResultFrame({
+              uuid: "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000b03",
+              result: "Still on it.",
+            }),
+          );
+          assert.equal((yield* Queue.take(harness.terminalReceipts)).status, "completed");
+          yield* harness.offerAndWait(
+            claudeSdkFrame({
+              type: "assistant",
+              message: {
+                model: "claude-sonnet-4-6",
+                id: "msg_stopped_run_nested_launch",
+                type: "message",
+                role: "assistant",
+                content: [
+                  {
+                    type: "tool_use",
+                    id: nestedToolUseId,
+                    name: "Agent",
+                    input: { description: "Nested check", prompt: "Reply with NESTED_OK" },
+                  },
+                ],
+              },
+              parent_tool_use_id: outerToolUseId,
+              uuid: "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000b04",
+              session_id: WAKE_NATIVE_SESSION,
+            }),
+          );
+          yield* harness.offerAndWait(
+            claudeSdkFrame({
+              type: "system",
+              subtype: "task_started",
+              task_id: nestedTaskId,
+              tool_use_id: nestedToolUseId,
+              description: "Nested check",
+              subagent_type: "general-purpose",
+              is_backgrounded: false,
+              spawn_depth: 2,
+              task_type: "local_agent",
+              prompt: "Reply with NESTED_OK",
+              uuid: "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000b05",
+              session_id: WAKE_NATIVE_SESSION,
+            }),
+          );
+          if (ending === "completed") {
+            yield* harness.offerAndWait(
+              claudeSdkFrame({
+                type: "system",
+                subtype: "task_progress",
+                task_id: nestedTaskId,
+                description: "Checking the nested result",
+                uuid: "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000b0a",
+                session_id: WAKE_NATIVE_SESSION,
+              }),
+            );
+            yield* harness.offerAndWait(
+              makeSubagentNotificationFrame({
+                taskId: nestedTaskId,
+                toolUseId: nestedToolUseId,
+                summary: "NESTED_OK",
+                uuid: "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000b0b",
+              }),
+            );
+          }
+          // Observe a later owner event so the subscriber has consumed the nested launch too.
+          yield* harness.offerAndWait(
+            claudeSdkFrame({
+              type: "system",
+              subtype: "task_progress",
+              task_id: outerTaskId,
+              description: "Waiting for the nested check",
+              uuid: "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000b06",
+              session_id: WAKE_NATIVE_SESSION,
+            }),
+          );
+          yield* Stream.fromQueue(harness.subagentReceipts).pipe(
+            Stream.filter((event) => event.subagent.progress === "Waiting for the nested check"),
+            Stream.take(1),
+            Stream.runDrain,
+          );
+          assert.lengthOf(harness.continuationRequests, 0);
+          if (ending === "completed") {
+            assert.deepEqual(
+              nestedRows().map(({ runId, parentNodeId, status }) => ({
+                runId,
+                parentNodeId,
+                status,
+              })),
+              [
+                { runId: owner.runId, parentNodeId: owner.id, status: "running" },
+                { runId: owner.runId, parentNodeId: owner.id, status: "running" },
+                { runId: owner.runId, parentNodeId: owner.id, status: "completed" },
+              ],
+            );
+            assert.isTrue(
+              harness.events.some(
+                (event) =>
+                  event.type === "node.updated" &&
+                  event.node.nativeItemRef?.nativeId === nestedTaskId &&
+                  event.node.rootNodeId === NodeId.make("node-attempt-claude-stopped-run-1"),
+              ),
+            );
+            assert.deepEqual(
+              {
+                nodes: harness.events.flatMap((event) =>
+                  event.type === "node.updated" &&
+                  event.node.kind === "subagent" &&
+                  event.node.nativeItemRef?.nativeId === nestedTaskId
+                    ? [event.node.providerTurnId]
+                    : [],
+                ),
+                cards: harness.events.flatMap((event) =>
+                  event.type === "turn_item.updated" &&
+                  event.turnItem.type === "subagent" &&
+                  event.turnItem.nativeItemRef?.nativeId === nestedTaskId
+                    ? [event.turnItem.providerTurnId]
+                    : [],
+                ),
+              },
+              {
+                nodes: [ownerNode.node.providerTurnId, ownerNode.node.providerTurnId],
+                cards: [
+                  ownerNode.node.providerTurnId,
+                  ownerNode.node.providerTurnId,
+                  ownerNode.node.providerTurnId,
+                ],
+              },
+              "the nested node and card retain the owner's original provider turn",
+            );
+            return;
+          }
+
+          assert.deepEqual(nestedRows(), [], "a stopped owner cannot ingest the launch");
+          yield* harness.offerAndWait(
+            makeSubagentNotificationFrame({
+              taskId: outerTaskId,
+              toolUseId: outerToolUseId,
+              summary: "OUTER_DONE",
+              uuid: "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000b08",
+            }),
+          );
+          yield* Queue.take(harness.continuationReceipts);
+          assert.deepEqual(nestedRows(), [], "the launch waits for the wake turn");
+          yield* harness.offerAndWait(
+            makeResultFrame({
+              uuid: "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000b09",
+              result: "The audit finished.",
+            }),
+          );
+          yield* harness.runtime.startTurn(
+            makeClaudeTestTurnInput({
+              threadId: harness.threadId,
+              providerThread: harness.providerThread,
+              now,
+              attemptId: RunAttemptId.make("attempt-claude-stopped-run-wake"),
+              text: "Background task completed.",
+              attachments: [],
+              providerTurnOrdinal: 3,
+              messageCreatedBy: "agent",
+              messageCreationSource: "provider",
+            }),
+          );
+          yield* Queue.take(harness.terminalReceipts);
+          assert.equal(nestedRows()[0]?.runId, RunId.make("run-attempt-claude-stopped-run-wake"));
+        }).pipe(
+          Effect.provide(
+            Layer.mergeAll(IdAllocator.layer, McpProviderSessions.layer, NodeServices.layer),
+          ),
+        ),
+      ),
+  );
+
